column1: # Hand labels for the name model, judged in context in the training texts (public-domain books, Wikipedia).
# person: a name or a name form one person goes by (given name alone, nickname, numbered name or honorific, a noble's title
# name, surname + one honorific character); place: a place, building, shop, organization; none: everything else (a word, a
# phrase, a fragment, a quantity, an item, a people, a title or office alone or after a surname, 'a certain Li').
# Judged by reading two places of each in the training texts (scripts/train_name_model.py texts): public-domain books from
# zh.wikisource and Chinese Wikipedia articles (CC BY-SA 4.0), never the held-out corpus, the samples or the owner's books.
# Columns: word as the text spells it, label.
